definitions: All pages receive beta for each method, fixed predicted local response and background logic unchanged otherwise. Variance-only c=.5*existing block8 variance. basis: For each C seed and layer/head, uncentered PCA of actual subgroup mean offsets on TRAIN physical page states, each unique ordered tokenIDs/rawK/summaryK identity counted once within trajectory. Four subgroup offsets equal weight. Top8 eigenvectors fixed, no dev labels/queries involved. Shared across pages/contexts within layer/head. FP32 basis, BF16 coefficients; full mean reference FP64.12 bases per seed, no basis search.
evaluation: M16 decision, actualQ64 pre-W_O NMSE, original Risk and Medium, one swap/no-op, same-information Independent. TrueBeta offline teacher. Refresh all predicted sums consistently, no teacher Dense in prediction. Five-state common panel conditional changes. Report beta bias/weighted error, positive actions, regret, per-event and pooled actual gains, P10,worst relative and absolute NMSE changes, history/current/candidate/background quality, recurrence-category coverage.
reliability_gate: LowRank8 both seeds: >=20% original same-pool Oracle gain recovery; both dev trajectories positive pooled gain; Set better than same-info Independent and E29; mean per-event gain nonnegative; degradation<=15%; P10 and worst relative no worse than E29. Also report restoration of E29-to-TrueBeta gap without clipping. No automatic deployment or training even if passing. If failing, stop this fixed configuration without tuning ranks/coefficients.
